crossRefs.note: Of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar.
On the second day Nethanel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, gave his offering.

people.name: Issachar
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, forefather of tribe

people.name: Zuar
people.line: Father of Nethanel, leader of Issachar

translations.web: Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar.
translations.bsb: Nethanel son of Zuar was over the division of the tribe of Issachar,
translations.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
translations.asv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethanel the son of Zuar.
